tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rdo rje dang dril bu'i rnam par bshad pa sngags 'chang rnams la gces pa'i nor rdzas zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru bud+dha dh+wa dza ye/ gangs ri'i khrod 'dir yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i bdag /sa skya'i bla chen kun dga' snying po'i mtshan/ /yab sras brgyud par bcas dang khyad par du/ /snyigs dus bstan pa'i nyi ma sngags 'chang rje/ /ngag gi dbang po kun dga' rin chen dang / /de sras 'jam dbyangs mched dang mus pa rje/ /dbyer med rang rig bla mar phyag btsal nas/ /sngags 'chang rnams la gces pa'i nor rdzas mchog /rdo rje dril bu'i rnam bshad 'dir spel gyi/ /blo gsal don gnyer skal bzang slob bu rnams/ /snyoms las ma byed legs bshad ri mor bris/ /rang gzhan don gnyis bsgrub phyir yid la zungs/ /zhes mchod par brjod cing bshad par dam bcas nas gzung bar gdams te/ 'dir rdo rje dang dril bu'i rnam par bshad pa sngags 'chang rnams la gces pa'i nor rdzas ces bya ba 'di 'chad pa la/ spyir gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i lam dang dngos grub thams cad kyi rtsa ba'i gzhir gyur pa ni/ dam tshig dang sdom pa la gnas pa yin la/ de'ang rgyud sde chen po bzhi la rang rang gi sngags sdom ma thob pa thob par byed pa'i dbang gi cho ga mi 'dra ba bzhi 'byung zhing / de dang rjes su 'brel ba dam tshig dang sdom pa'i srung tshul gyi rnam gzhag kyang cung zad/ mi 'dra ba bzhi 'byung ba las/ khyad par du rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i lugs kyi dam tshig mtha' dag kyang bsdu na/ gang zag lam gyi sa mtshams gyi dbang du byas na/ las dang po pa'i dam tshig brtan pa thob pa'i/ brtan pa cher thob pa'i dam tshig ste gsum du 'du bar bzhed do/ /de ltar gsum gyi dang po la/ bsrung bya'i dam tshig bza' ba'i dam tshig bsgrub pa'am bsten pa'i dam tshig mi 'bral ba'i dam tshig ste bzhi las/ gzhan gsum ni rang rang gi skabs su 'chad par 'gyur la/

'dir mi 'bral ba'i dam tshig bye brag tu bshad na/ spyir rgyud nas ji skad gsungs pa'i mtshan nyid can gyi bris sku/ glegs bam rdo rje dril bu/ ḍā ma ru/ ka pā la/ kha ṭ+wām̐ ga dgang gzar/ blugs gzar/ bgrang 'phreng / nā ra'i mi lpags/ chos gos/ stag gi sham thabs/ stag lpags sam ro ras kyi gdan/ rus pa'i rgyun drug sogs tshul bzhin du 'chang ba yin la/ de dag las kyang dam tshig gi rdo rje dril bu 'chang ba nyid mi 'bral ba'i dam tshig tu gsungs pas/ de'i rnam par bzhag pa bstan pal gnyis te/ mtshon bya don gyi rdo rje dril bu lo/ /mtshon byed brda'i rdo rje dril bu'o/ /dang po ni/ rgyud las/ byang chub sems gang de rdo rje/ shes rab dril bu zhes bshad do/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ thabs snying rje chen po dang ldan pa'i byang chub kyi sems ni don gyi rdo rje dang / shes rab spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba'i stong pa nyid ni don gyi dril bu ste/ de gnyis zung du 'jug pa'i sgo nas nam du'ang mi 'bral bar spyod pa'o/ /gnyis pa la brda'i rdor dril gyi rnam gzhag spyir bstan pa dang / dam tshig rdo rje dril bu khyad par du bshad pa gnyis kyi dang po la 'ang rdo rje dang dril bu'i rnam gzhag gnyis las/ dang po rdo rje la don bzhi ste/ dbye ba/ rgyu/ tshad dang mtshan nyid bstan pa/ rnam dag gam/ de kho na nyid bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ spyir rdo rje la dbye na/ rtse dgu pa ye shes rdo rje/ rtse lnga pa dam tshig gi rdo rje/ rtse gsum pa las kyi rdo rje/ rtse gcig pa klu rnams 'jig pa'i rdo rje/ rwa gyes pa khro bo'i rdo rje/ gsang ba rgyan gyi rdo rje ste drug gnad kyi gsal byed las/ gsungs so/ /gnyis pa de dag gi rgyu ni/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i le'u sum cu rtsa gcig pa las/ gser sogs las ni brdungs dge ba'i zhes gsungs te/ sogs khongs nas/ dngul/

'khar ba/ ljon dmar sogs la'ang bya zhes pa'i don to/ /gsum pa tshad dang mtshan nyid bstan pa la/ spyir rab 'bring gi tshad dang / cha so so'i tshad gnyis kyi dang po ni/ de'ang rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i rgyud las/ sor chung tshad/ brgyad pa'am bcu 'bring tshad/ bcu drug gam rab/ nyi shu rtsa/ gnyis de/ las lhag pa/ mi bya/ ste tshad las thal bar 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /zhes dang / bzang po yongs bzung las/ sor brgyad nas brtsams sor mo ni/ /nyi shu gnyis paragrangs mnyam bya/ de sor tshad kha spar ba mi bya zhes pa'i don no/ zhe bshad pas/ tha ma chung tshad sor brgyad pa nas/ 'bring tshad sor bcu drug pa/ rab che tshad sor nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa'i bar du bya zhing / de las lhag pa'i che ba mi rungs la/ gzhan yang sor mo gnyis cha bskyed dbri bya/ zhes 'byung bas sor brgyad nas nyi shu rtsa gnyis kyi bar du sor gnyis gnyis kyi 'phel 'grib shes par byas la/ sor brgyad/ bcu/ bcu gnyis/ bcu bzhi/ bco brgyad/ nyi shu/ nyer gnyis kyi bar che chung rang gi blo dang 'tshams pa'am rung bar bstan no/ /gnyis pa cha so so'i tshad ni/ rgyud sam̐ pu ṭi gdan bzhi ṭa ka dang gsum ka nas/ spyir rdo rje la/ cha gsum yod pa'i cha gcig bzung ba'i gnas te lte ba pad 'dab dang bcas par/ gsal zhing / zhes dang / rdo rje mkha' 'gror/ sum cha cha gcig bzung bar btsal/ /zhes gsungs pas/ spyir rab 'bring tshad gang yin yang / srid du cha gsum yod pa'i cha gcig bzung ba'i gnas te/ lte ba g.yas g.yon gyi pad+ma dang bcas pa cha gnyis g.yas kyi rwa rtsa nas rtse mo'i bar dang / de bzhin du g.yon gyi'ang ste/ de gsum cha mnyam por bya/ zhes pa'i don te/ rdo rje mkha' 'gror/ spyir srid du/ cha gsum pa yod/ pa yi tshad 'jal tshul/ kyis ni/ dbus te lte ba'i cha ste g.yas g.yon/ dang srid gyi ra cha mnyam pa nyid/

du gang gyur pa/ /'di ni spyi yi zhes pa rdo rje thams cad kyi/ tshad yin te/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /de las kyang cha zhib tu phye na/ rgyud rdo rje mkha' 'gror/ 'og gi dbus rwa/ dang steng rwa/ dang dbus kyi cha/ lte ba ste gsum po de nyid re re'ang gsum gsum ste/ so so ru ni rnam gsum gsungs/ /zhes bshad pas/ gong gi cha gsum po de re re'ang gsum gsum du bgos pa'i dbus rdo rje'i srid du cha dgu yod pa'i/ kyi dgu cha gcig ni lte ba'i tshad yin la/ dbyibs ni chos dbyings mtshon pas zlum por bya ba'am/ yang na rdo rje mkha' 'gror/ dbus kyi cha yi tshad kyis ni/ /lte bar yang dag gsungs pa yin/ /mar gad rin chen lta bu ni/ /cha brgyad rab tu mdzes pa'o/ /zhes zur brgyad pa'i dbyibs su bya bar yang bshad do/ /de lta bu'i lte ba de'i g.yas g.yon gnyis su mu tig phreng ba'i ske rags res bskor ba bya ste/ sam pu ṭir/ ske rags byas pa bzang po nyid/ /ces so/ /de'i g.yas g.yon gnyis su/ lte ba'i tshad dpangs su ldan pa'i pad+ma 'dab brgyad re'i steng du zla ba'i gdan re/ zla ba'i steng du cung zad phyir bskyed pa'i mu tig gi phreng ba res bskor ba/ zla ba zla ba mu khyud dang bcas pa'i rgya tshad ni/ rdo rje'i srid du gang yod pa'i sum gnyis thig skud kyi gzhal ba zlum por bkug pa la bya'o/ mu tig phreng ba'i dpangs ni/ pad+ma'i drug cha ste/ rdo rje mkha' 'gror/ lte ba'i g.yas g.yon/ pad+ma'i steng 'dab ma brgyad pa/ du gnas pa ni/ zla ba/ zla ba mu khyud dang bcas pa'i dpangs ni pad+ma'i/ drug cha dbyibs ni kun nas zlum pa'o/ /zhes dang / bzang po yongs bzung las/ chu skyes 'dab rgyas mdzes pa yi/ /mgo ste pad+ma'i steng zla ba'i phyi rol gyi mu khyud/ dang zhabs su zhes pa pad+ma'i rtsa ba dang lte ba'i mtshams su mu khyud de de ltar na/

phreng ba gnyis/ re 'byung / zhes dang / rwa brgyad rtsa ba'i yan lag zhes pa rwa rnams kyi gdan/ tu/ /pad+ma kha phye mu tig phreng ba'i/ ske rags brtag dbus kyi zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ cha las cung zad tsam/ /lhag ste phyir bskyed pa'i/ pa ske rags bya ba yin/ zhes gsungs/ 'di dag ni rdo rje rnam grangs sngar smos pa thams cad kyi spyir 'gro ba yin la/ bye brag tu rtse dgu par ni/ rdo rje mkha' 'gror/ pad+ma zla ba rnams gnas pa'i/ /phyogs mtshams kyi/ rwa rnams chu srin kha nas byung / /dbus dang bcas pa'i/ rtse mo dgu ru bshad pa ni/ ye shes kyi/ rdo rje ste/ phan yon/ 'gro ba sgrol/ /zhes dang / sam pu ṭir/ chu srin kha las byung ba yi/ /rtse mo 'od zer dang bcas pa gdan/ zla bar gnas/ rtse mo dgu pa rnams par bshad/ ces gsungs pas/ phyogs mtshams brgyad/ dbus kyi rwa dang dgu yin la/ de dag gi dbyibs tshad kyang dbus rwa'i yang ni gong du bshad pa bzhin rdo rje'i sum cha/ dbyibs zlum po brgyad zhogs kyi rnam pa/ rtsa rtse cung zad phra zhing dkyil ldir ba nas 'dra'i rnam pa ste/ mkha' 'gror/ rwa kun dbus ni zlum po'o/ /rnal 'byor pa/ blo dang / ldan pas/ dbus rwa/ ma la/ cha brgyad pa'i/ ste brgyad zhogs kyi rnam pa bya/ zhes dang / legs par bsdu ba las ces pa bzang po yongs bzung ngo / /dbus kyi rwa ni nas gzugs mtshungs/ ste nas 'dra'i rnam pa/ phyogs kyi cha las ma 'das pa'o/ / zhes pa dbus rwa dkyil du thad kar gnas shing dkyil du ma yo bar bya'o zhes/ zhes gsungs so /phyogs mtshams kyi rwa rnams ni/ rgyud rdo rje mkha' 'gror/ rtse mo kun gyi dbus ma zlum/ /phyogs sogs rtse mo 'dud pas gnas/ /ces dang / cha gsum ces pa dbus rang ma zad phyogs ra'i rwa re re'ang rtsa ba chu srin kha nas bzung ste/

pa ni mtha' yi rtse/ mo'i bar cha gsum bgos pas/ /cha gnyis dor nas phar gug ba rtse mo'i mtha'/ yin te/ rwa rnams kyi dbus su/ chud pa'i pad+ma'i/ 'dam mar gnas pa/ gang yin pa dbus rwa ste de la 'dud pa'i tshul gyis gnas par/ gsungs/ cha gcig chu srin kha yin te/ /zhes bshad pas/ g.yas g.yon gyi pad zla'i steng du rwa rtsa ba sum cha chu srin gyi kha na yod pa'i phyed gre ba'i nang du chud cing phyed ya 'gal ma 'gal gyi bar na gnas pa'i rtsa ba cung zad phyir bskyed pa dkyil gyi sum cha cung zad sbom pa/ thad ka'i cha la gnas shing / rtse mo'i cha cung zad byin gyi phra bar song ba/ mche ba'i dbyibs ltar gug nas/ rwa dbus ma la 'byar zhing 'dud pa'i tshul du gnas pa yin la/ dbus rwa'i rtse ni phyogs rwa rnams 'dod pa'i sa nas/ nas phyed kyi gyen du 'phags pa ste/ rdo rje mkha' 'gror/ lung 'di'i don grub chen bha ba bha dras/ mkha' 'gro'i 'grel par seng ge'i sna/ zhes bya ba 'di chu srin gyi sna'o/ /nas phyed tsam zhes bya ba 'di/ rdo rje'i rwa las phyir 'phags pa'i tshad do zhes gsungs mod/ 'dir ni bshad bde bas/ mchan rnying pa las 'byung ba bzhin du dbus rwa la 'bru bsnan te bshad pa'o/ seng ge'i sna ru gyur pa 'dis/ zhes pa seng ge'i sna gdong pa'i dkyil du 'byung ba ltar dbus rwa'ang rwa kun gyi dkyil du 'byung bas so/ /nas phyed tsam du mtho bar bya/ /zhes 'byung bas so/ /rgyud ḍi ka las/ rdo rje kun la blo ldan pas/ /mchu dang zheng ni mnyam por bya/ /zhes pa phyogs mtshams kyi rwa'i sbom pa nas thig skud kyis bskor ba dang / rdo rje'i srid mnyam por bya/ /zhes pa'i don yin gsung ngo / /gnyis pa dam tshig rdo rje ni/ 'og tu 'chad par 'gyur la/ gsum pa ni/ mkha' 'gror/ rtse gsum rwa gdengs po rnam 'gyur ba/ /de bzhin ma rungs sa bskrod/

par shes par byed pa'i rdo rje/ bya/ /zhes gsungs te/ lte ba pad zla dang bcas pa'i dbyibs tshad gong bzhin la/ dbus rwa'i mdun rgyab gnyis bor nas g.yas g.yon gnyis su rwa re dang bcas pa ste/ 'di la ma rungs pa bskrod par byed pa'i rdo rje zhes kyang bya'o/ /legs bsdur/ zhi dang ma zhi rab dbye bas/ /yang las kyi rdo rje la/ ni rnam pa gnyis su brjod/ /bzhi pa zhes pa legs bsdur rtse dgu rtse lnga las kyi rdo rje rtse gsum pa gsungs shing de la ltos pa'i zhi ba yin pas/ sna tshogs rdo rje nyid/ /phyogs re re'ang / rtse mo lnga dang ldan/ pa gdong bzhi zhes rgya gram yin/ yin/ zhes las kyi rdo rje la gnyis su byas nas/ zhi rgyas sogs las tshogs bsgrub pa la rtse mo lnga pa can gyi sna tshogs rdo rje dang ma zhi ba ste/ drag po'i las bsgrub pa la rtse gsum pa rwa gdengs pa 'byung bar bshad do/ /bzhi pa ni/ mkha' 'gror/ rdo rje rtse gcig par bshad pas/ klu rnams kun du skrag par byed/ /ces gsungs pas/ mtshan nyid phal cher 'dir bstan pa bzhin la/ phyogs rwa rnams dor nas/ dbus kyi rwa gru bzhi pa nas gzugs lta bu ste klu 'dul ba la khyad par du bsngags so/ /lnga pa ni/ mkha' 'gror/ gdeng pho rtse'i khro ba dang / lhag lhag ma ste rtse gsum pa bshad pa'i rjes su bstan pa khro bo'i rdo rje 'di'i/ ma lha la sogs pa/ gnon cing nges par gnon/ lha ma yin la sogs pa/ zhes bshad pas/ khro bo'i rdo rje'i ste rtse lnga pa'am/ rtse dgu pa gang yin kyang / phyogs rwa rnams rwa dbus ma la ma reg par/ gdengs pa'i rnam pa can du bya'o/ /drug pa ni/ mkha' 'gror de nas gzhan yang rnal 'byor pa rnams kyi rgyan du gdags par bya ba/ dag gsang ba yi/ /rdo rje'i mtshan nyid tshad dang bcas pa/ yang dag par/ bshad/ kyis nyon cig par ro/

/cha lnga pa yi sor mo'i/ tshad kyis ni/ /spyi gtsug rdo rje rab tu grags/ /cha drug 'gyur ba rna ba la'o/ /cha bzhi pa ni mgrin par ro/ /snying khar cha lnga pa nyid de/ /de bzhin cha drug gsang zhes pa bskyed pa nas mar 'phyang ba'o/ bar ro/ /lha mo lag par cha drug ste/ ji ltar mdzes pa rtag par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa rgyan gyi rdo rje ste/ /sna tshogs rdo rje'am gzhan rtse mo lnga pa'am/ gsum la sogs pa'ang rung ste/ de dag ni tshad sor mo dbus ma'i tshigs la bskor ba'i tshad ni cha gcig yin zhing / gzhan rnams des 'gre rgyu shes par bya'o/ /de lta bu rnal 'byor pa rgyan du 'dogs pa'i dgos pa'am/ don rtogs pa'i sgo nas ye shes 'phel ba'i phyir yin te/ mkha' 'gror/ rnal 'byor pa yi ye shes 'phel ba'i/ phyir/ rgyan gyi rdo rje yang dag gsungs/ /zhes 'byung bas so/ /bzhi pa rnam dag gam/ de kho na nyid bstan pa ni/ rdo rje rtse dgu pa'i lte ba zlum po ni/ de nyid bzhin/ pad+ma 'dab brgyad steng ma ni byang sems nye ba'i sras brgyad/ 'og ma ni lcags kyu zhags pa la sogs lha mo dag pa'i ngo bo yin la/ pad+ma'i steng gi zla ba ni/ 'khor ba'i gdung ba sel bar byed pa'i brda rwa rnams chu srin kha nas 'byung ba ni/ srid rtse'i sdug bsngal las 'dren pa'i mtshon byed yin zhing / steng gi dbus rwa ni rnam par snang mdzad/ phyogs kyi rwa gzhi ni rigs bzhi dang / mtshams kyi gzhi ni rigs gzhan bzhi dang yum bzhi/ 'og gi rwa dgu ni/ ye shes lnga dang / tshad med bzhi rnam par dag pa yin te/ mkha' 'gror/ ji ltar phyogs kyi rwa brgyad kyi/ dbus su sangs rgyas dgu pa'o/ /lha dgu la sogs rtse mo la/ /lha rnams dgu yi byin gyis brlabs/ /zhes sogs dang / saṃ pu ṭi las kyang / phyogs bzhi/ mtshams bzhi ste/ brgyad kyi dbus su ni dgu pa la zhes pa dbus su/

ni sangs rgyas rnam snang mdzad pa/ nyid/ /lha de ltar rigs lnga dang yum bzhi ste/ dgu ma sogs rtse mo ni/ /lha rnams dgu yis byin gyi brlabs/ /zhes sogs gsungs pas so/ /sna tshogs rdo rje ni 'phrin las sna tshogs kyis sems can gyi don byed pa mtshon zhing / gzhan rtse gsum pa sogs la dag ma dag ma bshad pas/ 'dir ma bris te/ de dag ni rdo rje'i rnam par bshad pa'o/ /gnyis pa dril bu'i rnam par bzhag pa'i bstan pa la'ang / dbye ba/ rgyu/ tshad dang mtshan nyid bstan pa/ rnam dag bam̐ de kho na nyid bstan pa ste bzhi las/ dang po ni/ spyir dril bu la dbye na/ ye shes kyi dril bu/ dam tshig gi dril bu/ tshe rings ba dang nad med par byed pa'i dril bu/ dpa' bo'i dril bu/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i dril bu ste lnga'o/ /gnyis pa de dag gi rgyu ni/ rdo rje mkha' 'gror/ dril bu/ thams cad kyi khog pa'i rgyu ni/ mkhar ba kho na la bya ba tshang mgo'i rgyu ni/ lcags gsum ste gser dngul zangs/ skyes/ /zhes dang / zho las gzhan pa'i tshang mgo gzhan ni rgyu/ gzhan las brtag pa yin/ /zhes bshad pas so/ /gsum pa la/ spyir rab 'bring gi tshad bstan pa dang / cha so so'i tshad bstan pa gnyis kyi dang po ni/ sor brgyad nas nyi shu rtsa gnyis kyi bar gang yang rung ba rdo rje'i tshad rjes su bstan pa bzhin/ 'dir yang yin te/ mkha' 'gror/ brgyad nas bcu drug bar dang ni/ /nyi shu gnyis lhag bya ba min/ /ji ltar rdo rje'i tshad dang / rjes su/ mthun par/ bsgrub pa'i dbang pos shes par/ bya ba yin/ /zhes dang / legs bsdur/ de ltar sor brgyad la sogs pa'i/ dril bu rdo rje'i rjes mthun sbyar/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa ni mkha' 'gror/ dril bu cha gsum ldan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa dril bu'i kha dang / kha nas steng du bcal ba dang / dbus dang sum cha mnyam por bya/ /zhes pa'i don yin la/

/bzang po yongs bzung du/ dril bu ngos de srid du zhes pa'i don/ kyi cha drug la/ de yi cha bzhi mkhar ba yi/ /zhes dril bu la srid du cha drug byas pa'i sum gnyis khog pa dang / sum cha dbu rtse la bya ba de/ rgyud nas gsungs pa dang gnyis gang 'thad byas pas chog par mngon no/ /dbyibs sam mtshan nyid ni mkha' 'gro/ /pad+ma rgyas pa kha phub pa lta bu'i dbyibs ltar byung ba/ zhes pa'i don/ /khog pa'i mgo zhabs 'tshams pa la/ /ba glang mchu zhes bya ba/ mchu 'thug pa phyir bskyed pa las slar yang nang du cung rub pa pad+ma kha bye ba lta bu'o/ /de'ang legs bsdur/ cung zad chu skyes kha phye ba'i/ /khar gyur gang yin ba glang mchu/ /zhes so/ /de lta bu'i legs kyi dbu zhabs gnyis la/ mu tig phreng ba gnyis sgrig re'i bar/ 'og tu 'phred dang / steng ma la dkyus su bsgrigs pa'i rdo rje'i phreng ba bya zhing / /de gnyis kyi bar rdo rje'i phreng ba gong ma las 'phyangs pa'i tshul gyis dra ba dang dra ba phyed pa byas te/ mkha' 'gror khog pa'i steng 'og tu/ rdo rje'i phreng ba ste de re re la'ang / ske rags gnyis/ dang ldan pa de gnyis kyi bar du dag pa'i/ shel ltar snang zhing dri med pa'i/ /dra ba dang dra ba phyed pas brgyan/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /khog pa de'i steng gi dbu rten gyi mthar/ ut+pa la'am ku mu ta'i/ /dbyibs kha bcu drug tu gyes pa'i phyi rol pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i steng du lha mo brgyad kyi sa bon bkod de/ de'ang shar du tam̐/ lhor lam̐/ nub tu mam̐/ byang du lam̐/ shar lhor bam̐ yig gam sum yig lho nub tu tsum̐/ nub byang du kram/ byang shar du mam̐ gi yi ge rnams mgo phyir bstan pa bya'o/ /de'ang mkha' 'gror/ phyogs brgyad du ni lha mo ni/ brgyad po'i ming can grags pa yin/ /de yi steng gyur sa bon las/ /lha mo brgyad po bsam par bya/ /shar du lha mo sgrol ma ste/

/de bzhin byang du gos dkar mo/ /nub tu mā ma ki zhes pa/ /lho ru sangs rgyas spyan ma'o/ /mdog bzang nor 'dzin ma/ mngar tsun+da/ ma 'od can khro gnyer can/ dang / /rin chen rdo rje'i phreng ba ma/ 'khyil pa rnams kyis bstan/ /zhes 'byung ba'i don yin la/ dbu rten de nyid kyi steng du ji ltar bya na/ rdo rje mkha' 'gror/ khog pa'i steng gi pad+ma kha phye pa lta bu/ las byung ba'i/ dbus/ gzugs med srid pa'i mtshon pa/ gnas su khog pa'i steng dbu rten bya/ ni/ shes rab bdud rtsi'i bum pa ste/ /ye shes de lta bu'i/ bdud rtsi'i gang ba'i bum pa/ gnas su ni/ de yi yang ni dbus su yid/ / ste chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba yid shes sbyongs ba'i/ lha mo shes rab pha rol phyin/ / ma'i zhal yongs su rdzogs par bya zhing de'i/ steng gi pad+ma rdo rje ni/ snga ma bzhin du bsam par bya/ /zhes pa dang / legs bsdur/ steng dang dbus su rim ji bzhin/ /ud pa la yi steng gi cha/ dbu sten/ steng gi gnas su phreng ba gsum/ rim pa/ gser bum pa'i rgyu/ dang zangs las/ ma bum pa'i/ bsnams pa/ bya ba'am/ yang na dngul gyi bum pa bya/ /de steng bum pa/ de yi tshad tsam la/ /shar du shes rab gdong pa bya/ /gdong ste sngon gyi rdo rje phyed/ /rdo rje phyed pa nyid ni bya/ /zhes bshad pas/ gser zangs sogs kyi rgyu las grub pa'i phreng ba rim pa gsum phyir bskyed pa/ pad+ma kha phye ba lta bu'i steng du bdud rtsi bum pa'i lte bar gnas shing / de'i steng du lha mo shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa'i zhal/ shar gyi tam yig la gzigs pa'i steng / pad+ma zla ba'i steng du rdo rje rtse dgu sogs rang rang gi dbu rtses mtshan pa'o/ /gzhan yang sam̐ pu ṭi las/ nang gi gzugs ni nam mkha' ste/ /khong stong de'i steng du bum pa'i/ gzugs dang lha'i zhal sogs mtshan nyid kun/

rdzogs shing / yon tan thams cad 'byung ba'i/ gnas/ su gyur pa'o/ /zhes dang / mkha' 'gror/ nam mkha'i phyogs kyi dbus su ni/ /gzugs rdzogs yon tan rnams kyi gzhi/ /zhes pa'i don dbu rten gyi rtser phreng ba gsum gyis bskor ba'i steng du bum pa dang / lha mo'i zhal rdzogs pa la bzhed do/ /khog pa de'i dbus su ji ltar 'tshams pa'i lce lcags sam khro las grub pa sgra 'byin pa'i phyir/ nang gi rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma gdags par bya ste/ mkha' 'gror/ khog pa'i/ dbus su ye shes dbyug pa ste lce/ ni/ lha/ thams cad spro zhing dbang du/ sdud par byed/ ces dang / sam̐ pu ṭir/ nang gi kha dog ye shes dbyug gu ni/ /lha/ thams cad dbang du/ sdud cing sgra/ 'byin par byed/ pa'i dgos pa 'dod/ ces gsungs so/ /de dag gi don yang lce des dril bu'i khog pa la bskul ba'i stobs kyis lha thams cad dbang du sdud cing sgra sna tshogs 'byin par byed ces pa'o/ /de dag gis ni dril bu thams cad kyi phyag tshad dang mtshan nyid yin la/ bye brag tu ye shes kyi dril bu ni mkha' 'gro/ khong stong sgra ni zab pa ste/ /dga' ba kun gyi ro ni 'dzin/ /ut+pal ku mu ta nyid dang / /rin chen pad+mas nye bar brgyan/ /ces dang / ye shes rdo rjer dang zung du/ gyur pa'i/ dril bu/ ni/ rdo rje lta bur/ rtse mo dgu pa de bzhin no/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /khog pa'i logs kyi dra ba'i dkyil rnams su/ /shar du ku mu ta/ lhor rin po che/ nub tu pad+ma/ byang du ut+pa la rnams kyi spras shing gzhan sngar bstan pa ltar gyi mtshan nyid thams cad dang ldan pa'i dbu rdo rje phyed pa rtse dgu pas brgyan pa'o/ /de nyid kyi dgos pa'ang / mkha' 'gror/ zhi rgyas sogs/ las rnams thams cad sgrub par/ byed cing / dngos grub 'jigs rten las 'das pa'i/

mchog ni ster bar byed/ /ces gsungs pas shes so/ /gnyis pa dam tshig rdo rje dril bu ni/ /'og tu 'chad par 'gyur la/ gsum pa ni/ mkha' 'gror/ sor srid du/ mo bcu gnyis kyi/ tshad tsam la/ khog pa'i log la/ rdo rje phreng ba ske rags bcas/ /khog pa'i dbyibs dbang po mchog gi 'dab ma ste pad+ma dang mtshungs pa yang / dra ba dra ba phyed pas brgyan/ /mdor na/ sngon bzhin mtshan nyid thams cad/ dang ldan zhing / khyad par/ lha mo'i mtshan ma rnams kyis spras/ pa ste/ shar du gnas pa'i pad+ma ni/ /kha dog dkar po rab mdzes pa'o/ /gshin rje ste lhor/ 'i khu byug sgra byung tsam na sngo skye bas des mtshon pa ut+pal/ sngon po/ /nub tu 'dam skyes pad+ma dmar po/ dmar po ste/ /byang du de bzhin ut+pal ljang khu/ sbyin/ /steng gi bdud rtsi gnas kyi te bum pa'i/ dbus su ni/ /zhal gcig pa ni rab tu gnas/ /zhal de nyid gang gis yin na/ shes rab kyi/ pha rol tu/ phyin pa'i/ lha mo/ pa'i zhal de'ang / gzugs bzang la/ yon tan rnams kyi gzhi/ 'o/ /steng du pad+ma rdo rje ste sngon bzhin du ni bsam par bya/ /dbus kyi ye shes dbyig pa 'i khyad par/ ni/ /cha brgyad kyis ni rnam par spras/ /zhes tshad sngar bstan pa bzhin sor bcu gnyis pa khog pa'i logs la pad+ma ut+pal sogs kyi mtshan nyid ma bkod cing / dbyig pa ste lce rgya zhogs rnam par bya'o/ /de lta bu bshad pa'am/ rnal 'byor pas bcas pa'i dgos pa dang / mkha' 'gror/ lha chen mo zhes zhu ba po la bos nas/ dril bu 'di lta bu bshad pa'i dgos pa 'di/ yin te/ tshe sgrub pa po/ rings shing / nad med ni med pa dang longs spyod/ phun sum tshogs/ /de bzhin du/ shes rab ldan par 'gyur/ zhes bya/

/zhes gsungs/ bzhi pa ni/ mkha' 'gror/ rdo rje phreng ba dang / ske rags bum pa/ bzang / po sogs/ /mtshan nyid thams cad rab tu/ rdzogs par bya/ mod mod kyi 'on kyang / dra ba dang / dra ba/ phyed pa'i/ mtshan ma spangs/ pa ste mi bya'o/ /sor de'i tshad srid du/ mo dgu yi tshad btsal la/ /de yi kha 'i zheng / ni sor lnga yi/ /tshad las lhag pa mi bya'o/ /rtse dbu rtse ni/ lnga pa dang rtse dgu pa/ gang rung ste/ dpa' bo'i dril bur yang dag gsungs/ rdo rje 'dzin pa/ /ces bshad pas mtshan sngar gyi/ mtshan nyid bzhin la/ 'on kyang dra ba dra phyed spangs pa/ tshad srid du sor dgu pa'i kha la sor lnga'i tshad dang ldan zhing / rtse lnga'am rtse dgu gang rung gis spras pa'o/ /'di la rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i dril bu zhes kyang bshad do/ /de lta bu bzung ba'i phan yon mang / skal bzang sogs/ kun dang gzhan yang / dbang phyug dang / /sngags kun gyis ni 'bras bu ster/ /mkha' 'gro ma kun rdzu 'phrul dang / stobs/ dang / phun tshogs la sogs te/ dge ba dang rab tu legs pa thams cad/ rab tu stsol/ bar mdzad/ de mdor na/ gshegs pa/ kun gyi dngos grub ni/ bzang po mchog tu gyur pa rnams/ ni rab tu stsol/ zhes bsngags pa rgya cher gsungs so/ /lnga pa de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga'i dril bu ni/ rdo rje mkha' 'gror/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs lnga po/ rnams kyis/ dril bu'i mtshan nyid rab tu bshad/ mkhar khog pa/ ba'i rang bzhin la byas pa/ sgra snyan par/ byed/ khong steng bum pas brgyan pa ste/ /rdo rje rin chen pad+ma dang / /ral gri la sogs mtshan mar ldan/ /dra ba dra ba phyed brgyan zhing / /rwa rnams chu srin kha nas 'byung / /ye shes lnga ni rnam dag pa/ /rtse mo lnga ni mdo ru bsdus/

/zhes mdor bstan nas/ /de nyid rgyas par bshad pa/ ske khog pa'i/ rags gnyis kyi dbus su ni/ /'khor rnam snang gi dril bu la/ lo'i phreng ba gnyis dang ldan/ de bzhin ske rags gnyis dbus su/ 'od dpag med la/ pad+ma'i phreng ba gnyis dang ldan/ rin chen dbang gis rin chen te rin 'byung la/ ldan/ phreng ba gnyis dang / de bzhin du yang ske rags te/ don yod dril bu la/ ral grir 'i phreng ba/ bshad pa ni/ de bzhin ske rags gnyis su dbus su/ /zhes dang / de ltar/ rdo rje sogs/ rigs kyi dril bu la/ ba glang kha/ dang / rdo rje phreng ba ske rags sogs dang / ldan/ sngar bzhin byas pa las khyad par du bum pa'i gdan/ rab tu/ mdzes pa'i/ kha khyer bya zhing / gru bzhi pa/ bya zhing / steng du bum pa yang dag gnas/ /zhes 'byung bas/ bum pa'i gdan gru bzhi pa'i dbyibs dang / dbu la rdo rje phyed pa rtse lnga kho na bya zhing / gzhan gong gi mtshan nyid ji lta ba la khog pa'i legs kyi dbu zhabs su/ rdo rje'i phreng ba gnyis yod pa'i bar rnam snang gi dril bu la 'khor lo dang / de bzhin du rin chen rigs kyi dril bu la rin po che'i phreng ba gnyis gnyis bya ba sogs sam/ yang na rdo rje'i ske rags kyi dod la/ rang rang gi rigs dang rjes su 'brel ba'i rigs so so'i mtshan ma'i ske rags gnyis gnyis bya bar yang rung zhes bshad do/ /de ltar de bzhin gshegs pa'i dril bu mtshan nyid dang ldan pa bzung ba'i phan yon kyang / ba glang kha sogs mtshan nyid ldan pa'i dril bu bcas pa'i dus/ myur ba ru/ /nor rin po che sogs/ chen dang gzhan yang / 'bru 'i tshogs/ ni 'bad med du/ 'byung bar 'gyur/ /rtag dus/ tu nad med cing / stobs dang mdangs/ ni ster bar byed/ nad gdon sogs/ sdug bsngal kun sgrib pa'i/

dang dri ma ma lus par/ sel/ /zhes gsungs so/ /bzhi pa rnam dag gam de kho na nyid ni legs bsdur/ khog pa'i/ nang na gnas pa'i nam mkha' ni/ stong so/ /gzugs med pa yi khams rnam par/ dag pa'o/ /gzugs khams rnam par dag pa mtshon byed/ 'di/ 'i gang dang sbyor na/ ut+pal dbu rten gyi rtsa bar gnas pa'i/ rtsa ba kha bye ba/ lta bu sogs dang gzhan yang / shes rab bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin gnas/ /shes rab pha rol phyin pa'i gzhi/ /steng gi chu skyes rdo rje ni/ /rdo rje lta bur rnam par bsam/ ste 'di rnams la sbyar ro/ /zhes bshad pas/ sbyangs gzhi khams gsum dang / sbyongs byed sku gsum gyi mtshon byed dang sbyar na/ nang gi nam mkha' gzugs med dang chos sku/ khog pa'i lha dang / mtshan ma la sogs pa sna tshogs su snang ba/ sprul sku dang 'dod khams dang / bum pa yan chad gzugs khams dang / longs sku rnam par dag pa yin la/ cung zad rgyas par 'og tu 'chad do/ /de ltar spyi'i rnam par gzhag sngon du song nas/ da ni don gyi gtso bor dam tshig gi rdo rje dang dril bu bye brag tu bshad par bya ste/ de la'ang mtshan nyid dang / de kho na nyid bshad pa dang / de kho na nyid ma shes pa'i nyes dmigs dang / de nyid shes pas ji ltar bzung ba'i tshul cho ga dang bcas pa bstan pa'o/ /dang po la'ang gnyis kyis/ dam tshig rdo rje'i mtshan nyid rgyu dang dbyibs tshad la sogs pa'i rnam par gzhag pa phal che ba ni/ gong du bstan pa bzhin yin te/ rdo rje mkha' 'gror/ de nas rnal 'byor pas mi 'bral ba'i/ dam tshig tu bzung bar bya ba'i/ rdo rje yi/ /mtshan nyid tshad dang / yang dag bshad par bya/ /rgyu/ gser sogs las/ brdungs pa'i rdo rje de/ yi/ tshad kyis cha yang de bzhin cha gsum sogs gong du/ gsungs pa ltar/ ste/ sngon bzhin rdo rje ske rags sogs/

mtshan nyid dang ldan zhing / /pad+ma zla bar rnam par gnas/ /chu srin so yi rnam pa yi/ /rtsa ba chu srin kha las byung / /zhes gsungs pas shes la/ khyad par du rwa'i grangs ni/ gang yang sboms su gyur pa yi/ /rwa ni ye shes rang bzhin gsungs/ /zhes 'byung bas/ ye shes lnga'i grangs dang mthun par/ rtse lnga pa kho nar bya zhing / dbu rwa'i dbyibs ni/ gru bzhi pa nas gzugs lta bur bya'o/ /sam̐ bhu ṭi las kyang / ye shes rdo rjes 'gro ba 'don/ /zhes pa ye shes dag pa'i rtse lnga pa can gyi dam tshig rdo rje de nyid shes pas bcangs na 'khor bar 'gro ba las 'don pa'i don te/ 'dis dam tshig rdo rje bstan zhes man ngag gi bshad pa la gsungs so/ /dam tshig dril bu'i mtshan nyid ni rgyud gnyis las dngos bstan gsal bar ma gsungs kyang / gdan bzhir/ sbyor ba'i gdan gyi rab tu byed pa dang por/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i mtshan nyid gsungs nas/ de ma thag dril bu'i mtshan nyid bstan pa'i skabs su/ steng du rdo rje pad+mo dag ji ltar mngon bzhin bsam par bya/ /zhes rdo rje phyed pa rtse lnga pas mtshan pa'i dril bu bshad pas bstan la/ de'i dbyibs tshad rgyu la sogs pa spyir bstan pa'i gnas skabs bzhin las/ khyad par du/ rdo rje'i phreng ba gnyis kyi bar dra ba phyed dam 'khor lo'i phreng ba gang rung bya zhing / dbu rtse ni rdo rje phyed pa rtse lnga pa'i dbyibs su bya'o/ /gnyis pa de kho na nyid la gnyis las/ dang po rdo rje'i rnam dag ni/ sbyangs gzhi'i dbang du byas na/ steng 'og gi rwa lnga lnga ni/ nyon mongs pa lnga dang phung po lnga/ lte ba zlum pos ni de dag gi chos nyid dang bcas pa sbyongs la/ sbyongs byed kyi dbang du byas na/ rgyud las/ lha ni nyi shu rtsa bdun ldan/ /steng 'og gi rwa lnga la lha lnga lnga ste bcu/ steng 'og gi pad+ma bcu drug ste/ nyi shu rtsa drug lte ba'i rdor sems yab yum ste/ de ltar nyi shu rtsa bdun no/

/'di la man ngag tu/ lte ba'i yab yum so sor bgrangs nas rtsa brgyad du byed pa'ang byung ngo / /zhes gsungs shing / de'ang zhib tu phye na/ dbus su ye shes sems dpa' ni/ zhes pas/ lte bar rdo rje sems dpa'/ steng gi rwa lnga ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i ngo bor rnam par dag pa ste/ mkha' 'gror/ kun gyi dbus su rnam snang mdzad/ shar du mi bskyod pa nyid de/ lho yi rwa la rin chen 'byung / /nub tu 'od dpag med pa dgod/ /byang du don yod grub pa ste/ /rwa bzhi la sogs pa yi lha/ /zhes so/ /'og gi rwa lnga ni/ lha mo lnga'i ngo bo ste/ dbus dang shar la sogs pa yi/ /rwa bzhir mkha' 'gro ma rnams dgod/ /shar du rdo rje mkha' gro ma/ /byang du 'jigs ma zhes bya ba/ /nub tu ro langs ma ni gnas/ /lho ru gtum mo gnas pa ste/ dbus su ye shes mkha' 'gro ma/ /dam tshig rdo rje can bsgoms bya/ /zhes gsungs la/ lte ba'i cha la brten pa steng gi pad+ma 'dab brgyad ni/ byang chub kyi lam yan lag brgyad mtshon zhing / sems dpa' brgyad kyi rang bzhin du dag pa ste/ sa 'dab ma brgyad pa/ brgyad byang chub yan lag gi ngo bor dag cing / de/ ji lta ba/ bzhin gyi/ gnas su bzhag pa ste bkod par/ bya ba/ /pad+ma'i phyag spyan ras gzigs/ dang byams pa dang / nam mkha'i mdzod dang kun du bzang / /gnod sbyin bdag po phyag rdor/ 'jam pa'i dpal/ /sgrib pa sel dang sa snying nyid/ /'di yi lha ni brgyad po rnams/ /ji bzhin 'dab mar brtag par bya/ /zhes dang / 'og gi 'dab ma brgyad ni/ pad+mar lha mo brgyad gang yin/ /ji bzhin gnas su sbyar bar bya/ /rdo rje lcags kyu zhags pa ma/ rdo rje lcags sgrog dril bu ma/ /lha mo bzhi po 'di dag ni/ /phyogs kyi 'dab mar rnam par gnas/ /mtshams kyi 'dab ma bzhi po la/ /lha mo bzhi po de ltar yang / /skul byed rin chen sgrol lha mo/

/rdo rje lu gu rgyud ces dang / /de bzhin gzhan gyis mi thub ma/ /thams cad 'das mar dgod par bya/ /zhes lha mo brgyad kyi ngo bor rnam par dag cing / gzhan yang pad+ma 'dab brgyad ni/ shes rab dang / zla ba'i dkyil 'khor ni thabs kyi mtshon byed yin pas/ thabs shes zung 'jug mu khyud dang chu srin gyi mgo bo 'khor ba'i mtshon byed/ rwa rnams ni/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i mtshon byed yin la/ mdor na mtshon byed rdo rje 'dis mtshon pa'i/ /mtshon bya sbyangs gzhi rnams ni 'khor ba/ sbyongs byed lha rnams ni mya ngan las 'das pa ste/ de gnyis phan tshul rgyu 'bras ro gcig tu rtogs pa'am/ rang gi sems kyi dbyings gcig nyid du shes pa ni/ 'khor 'das dbyer med ces bya ba de kho na nyid mthar thug pa ste/ 'di ni kho bos legs par bshad pa'o/ /gnyis pa dril bu'i de kho na nyid la/ sgra'i de kho na nyid/ gzugs kyi de kho na nyid bstan pa gnyis kyi dang po ni/ sam̐ bhu ṭi las/ shes rab dkrol ba'i de nyid ni/ /lha rnams kun gyis thos par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pas/ /shes rab ni stong pa nyid yin la/ /dkrol ba ni/ de'i don mtshon par byed pa/ dril bu'i sgra ste/ sgra des chos thams cad stong pa nyid/ mngon par 'dus ma byas pa dang / rang bzhin gyi rnam par dag pa ston par byed pa'o/ /de'i dgos pa'ang / sam̐ bhu ṭi las/ nam mkha'i khams kyi mthar thug par/ /byang chub snying por rnam par gnas/ /phyogs bcu thams cad rig pa'i gnas/ /'jig rten khams ni mtha' yas pa/ /zhes gsungs te/ de lta bu'i dril bu'i sgra des/ phyogs bcu nam mkha'i mthar thug pa/ /dus byang chub snying po'i bar du stong pa nyid brjod par byed pa'i sgras khyab par byed par bsam zhing / de nyid sems can gyi khams mtha' yas pa ma rig pa'i gnyid las sad par byed pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ sam̐ bhu ṭi las/ phyogs ni brgyad ces bya ba ni/ lha mo brgyad ni rab tu grags/

yi ge brgyad kyi sa bon ni/ phyogs ni brgyad du rnam par dgod/ shar du lha mo sgrol ma ste/ zhes sogs dang / nang gi khog pa'i/ gzugs ni nam mkha' ste/ gzugs med mtshon la/ gzugs kyi gang ba gzi brjid can/ ni lha'i zhal la sogs te gzugs khams mtshon/ dbyibs ni/ pad+ma kha phye ba lta bu/ las byung ba/ gzugs med srid sa mtshon/ pa'i khog pa dbu rten dang bcas pa'i/ gnas su ni/ /shes rab bdud rtsi'i bum pa lta/ /ye shes bdud rtsi'i gnas su ni/ /de yi dbus su yid kyi ni/ /lha mo shes rab pha rol phyin/ /gzugs ni mdzes shing yon tan gnas/ /zhes gsungs pas/ nang gi nam mkha' stong pa/ gzugs med kyi khams dang chos sku/ khog pa'i lha dang mtshan ma la sogs pa sprul sku dang 'dod khams/ bum pa dang lha mo'i zhal ni gzugs khams dang longs sku yin la/ rdo rje phyed pa ni/ de lta bu'i sbyangs gzhi khams gsum dang / sbyongs byed sku gsum dbyer mi phyed pa'i don to/ /yang khog pa kho na dang / sku gsum mtshon byed du sbyar na/ nang gi khog pa stong pa ni chos sku/ de gnyis las ye shes kyi dbyig pa gnas brgyad du bskrod pa sprul sku/ gsung rnam dag 'byung ba longs sku'o/ /gzhan yang lha dang sbyar ba ni/ /khog pa'i steng gi sa bon brgyad lha mo brgyad/ steng gi lha'i zhal ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma rnams par dag pa yin la/ gzhan pad+ma 'dab brgyad rdo rje phyed pa ni gong du bstan pa ltar byang sems nye ba'i sras brgyad dang / rigs lnga'i ngo bor dag ste/ sam̐ bhu ṭi las/ steng gi pad+ma rdo rje rnams/ ji ltar gong bzhin bsam par bya/ /zhes 'byung bas so/ /'di la'ang 'khor 'das bsre tshul gong bzhin shes par bya ste/ dril bu'i de kho na nyid do/ /gsum pa de kho na nyid ma shes pa'i nyes dmigs ni/ sngar bstan ma thag pa'i de nyid rnams mi shes kyang /

rdo rje dril bu bcangs pa la phan yon yod dam snyam na ma yin te/ sam̐ bhu ṭi'i brtag pa bzhi pa'i rab byed gnyis pa las/ rdo rje dril bu'i cings mi shes pa rnams kyi bcangs kyang / de nyid med/ /phyag rgya'i de nyid dngos grub/ skyes bar/ mi 'gyur/ ro/ zhes dang / brgyad pa'i dang po las/ de nyid med kyang sngags par/ sems pa'i/ rnal 'byor pas/ glang po che'i mgul gyi/ dril bu 'khrol ba nyid/ dang mtshungs ste/ rnal 'byor de nyid dman pa yi/ /rang gi dngos grub rab tu rtag /ces gsungs shing / mkhas pa smṛ tis kyang / rdo rje'i de nyid mi shes par/ /brgya byin lag gi mtshon cha bzhin/ /zhes bshad pas/ de kho na nyid mi shes pa'i rnal 'byor pas rdo rje dril bu bcangs kyang / phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub las rings te/ dper na brgya byin gyi rdo rje'am/ rta dang / glang po'i mgul rgyan gyi dril bu bzhin no/ /bzhi pa de nyid shes pas ji ltar bzung ba'i tshul cho ga dang bcas pa bstan pa la/ de nyid shes pa'iphan yon/ byin rlabs bya ba'i tshul/ blangs pa'i cho ga dkrol ba'i grangs dang bcas pa bstan pa/ mi 'bral ba/ bzung ba'i phan yon dang bcas pa bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ sam̐ bhu ṭa brgyad pa'i dang po las/ thabs dang shes rab zung du 'jug pa'i/ chos de nyid shes pa rnams/ kyis ni/ /'gro ba dang rten 'brel bcu gnyis kyi/ po ma rig pa las/ sad par byed/ /mi shes 'dam du byings ba yis/ /sems can sangs rgyas don du grol/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ de nyid shes pas bcangs shing dkrol ba'i stobs kyis/ 'gro ba rnams rten 'brel bcu gnyis kyi dang po ma rig pa'i gnyid las sad par byed pa dang / mi shes pa'i 'khor ba'i 'dam du byings pa'i sems can rnams sangs rgyas kyi go 'phangs thob par byed pa'i don no/ /gnyis pa ni/

sngar ji skad bshad pa ltar gyi mtshan nyid ldan pa'i lha'i rdo rje dril bu mngon par 'du byas te/ rang nyid kyi mdun du stegs bu la sogs pa'i gzhi la/ rdo rje g.yas dang dril bu g.yon du go ma nor rnal 'byor pa rang la ltos pa'i g.yas g.yon du shes dgos/ bar bzhag rgyun gyi tshe dril bu'i zhal rdo rje'i lte ba la blta bar bshad kyang / skabs 'dir rdo rje dril bu rab gnas dus dmigs pa bde phyir/ dgos pa'i dbang gis rang la bstan par bya/ 'byor na mchod pa rnam lnga'ang bshams/ /de nas rang gi lha'i rnal 'byor sngon du 'gro bas/ bgegs/ sdig pa/ dri ma sbyang ba ste/ sbyangs ba rnam gsum gyi sbyangs ma grub na bgegs bskrad pa dang / bkru ba tsam bya/ de nas swa bhā was stongs par sbyangs pa'i ngang las/ rdo rje dang dril bu so sor mi bskyod par bskyed/ de dag zhu ba las byung ba'i/rdo rje dang dril bu/ rang rang gi rnam pa ji lta ba bzhin du gyur pa'i rdo rje tshad dang mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa'i lte bar rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum/ steng gi rwa lnga la/ dbus su rnam par snang mdzad/ shar du mi bskyod pa/ lhor rin 'byung / nub tu 'od dpag med/ byang du don yod grub pa/ rwa'i 'og gi pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad la/ shar du spyan ras gzigs/ lhor byams pa/ nub tu nam mkha' mdzod/ byang du kun du bzang po/ byang shar du phyag na rdo rje/ shar lhor 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ lho nub tu sgrib pa rnam sel/ nub byang du sa'i snying po/ 'og gi 'dab ma brgyad la/ shar du rdo rje lcags kyu ma/ lhor zhags pa ma/ nub tu lcags sgrog ma/ byang du dril bu ma/ byang shar du bskul byed ma/ shar lhor rin chen glog lho nub tu lu gu brgyud ma/ nub byang du gzhan gyi mi thub ma/ 'og gi rwa lnga la/ dbus su ye shes mkha' 'gro/ shar du rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ lhor gtum mo/ nub tu rol langs ma/

byang du 'jigs pa'i mkha' 'gro ma/ dril bu mkhar ba sogs las grub pa/ tshad dang mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa'i bum par/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma yab dang bcas pa khog pa'i steng / ut+pal gyi shar gyi 'dab ma la/ lha mo sgrol ma/ lhor spyan ma/ nub tu mā ma ki byang du gos dkar mo/ byang shar du nor rgyun ma/ shar lhor tsun+da/ lho nub tu khro gnyer can/ nub byang du rdo rje phreng ba ma/ steng gi 'dab ma brgyad la sems dpa' brgyad dang / rwa lnga la rigs lnga sngar bzhin bsgom/ thams cad kyang rgyan cha lugs sku mdog dang bcas pa re re nas gsal gdab pa mi dgos dran rdzogs su/ yongs su rdzogs par lam gyi ltas la/ gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs/ ye shes pa spyan drangs ba rgyas bsdus gang yang rung ba byas te bstims/ dbang bskur rigs kyi bdag po rdo rje sems dpa' rgyas gdab/ mchod bstod spyan dbye byas la/ brtan bzhugs dang shis pa brjod pa sogs kyang rgyas par bya ste/ de dag ni byin gyis brlabs pa'i cho ga'o/ /gsum pa ni/ sam̐ bhu ṭi'i brgyad pa'i dang po las/ rang gi 'dod pa'i/ lha ste yi dam gang yin la/ ni bsam par bya/ /zhes dang / thabs lag pa g.yas/ dang g.yon/ shes rab lag pa'i dngos/ /g.yas pa la/ nyi ma dang rdo rje dang bcas pa/ yang dag par/ bsam/ g.yon par yang ni pad+ma/ zla ba nyid/ dang bcas/ ces gsungs pas/ de ltar byin gyis brlabs pa sngon du song nas/ rang lhar gsal ba'i lag pa g.yas pa hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ lte ba la nyi sting hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ g.yon pa la aḥlas byung ba'i pad+ma 'dab ma lnga pa/ lte bar zla mtshan pa/ de gnyis zhu ba las byung ba'i lag par ltas la/ de nas sam̐ bhu ṭir/ de la lag gnyis rab tu bskyangs/ /rnam par 'dod pa bskor ba bya/ /zhes bshad pas/ ngag tu hūm̐ aḥzhes brjod cing / rnam lnga 'dod pa'i bskor ba bya/

de'i rjes su/ sam̐ pu ṭir/ ā li kā li dgos pa ni/ /zhes ā li kā li ni thabs shes te/ des mthe bong thabs dang / srin lag shes rab gnyis bstan pasagayas pa mthe bong dang / srin lag gis rdo rje blang ste/ ngag tu/ oṃ mahā badz+ra zhes brjod/ de nas hūm̐ lan gsum brjod pa dang bcas pas/ rgyud nas byang du zhes pa'i don/ /g.yas pa nas g.yon du cung zad phyogs te/ snying kha nas smin mtshams kyi bar du lan gsum gsor bas/ sangs rgyas thams cad dgyes par mos/ /mthar snying khar bzung ste/ thog ma dang mtha' med pa'i byang chub kyi sems kyi ngo bo zhes de kho na nyid dran par bya/ de ltar yang sam̐ bhu ṭi las/ byang du rdo rje gsor nas ni/ /rlung hūm̐ gi glu'i rnam pa yis/ /sangs rgyas thams cad rgyas par bya/ /rdo rje gsor ba mdzes pa yis/ /rmongs pa'i sems can rnams par dgrol/ /chos kyi rnam thar 'bras bu nyid/ /rdo rje dgyes pa 'dzin pa ste/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /yang g.yon pa'i mthe bong dang / srin lag gis dril bu blangs shing / oṃ badz+ra gaṇ+ḍe aḥzhes pas dkur bkan te bzung la/ srid pa thams cad rang bzhin gyi dag pa ston par byed pa gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cu'i ngo bo zhes de nyid dran par bya/ de nas dharma ra ṇi ta'i sngags brjod cing dril bu phyogs kun du bskor zhing / nang gi lce phyogs khog pa'i/ mtshams brgyad du dkrol skyod nas/ ba ste/ sam̐ bhu ṭir/ phyi rdo rje gsor ba de'i/ nas blo ldan dril bu/ yang dag par/ dkrol/ tshul/ gnas ni brgyad du bskyod par bya/ /zhes so/ /de ltar gnas brgyad du bskyod pa'i dgos pa'ang / phyi rol du dur khrod brgyad na bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro rnams kyi thugs bskul te/ bdag rgyud byin gyis brlabs par 'gyur ba dang nang du snying ga'i rtsa 'dab brgyad bskul bas/ bde chen gyi ye shes skye ba'i phyir yin gsungs so/

/de dag kyang bsdu na/ rdo rje thugs sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig las logs su gyur pa gzhan med pa'i phyir/ kyi dam tshig dril bu gsung gi dam tshig rang nyid lhar gsal ba'i lha sku phyag rgya'i dam tshig ste/ mi bskyod pa'i dam tshig gi skabs su/ rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya yang / zhes pa'i don yang 'di nyid yin la/ rdo rje theg pa'i nyams len gyi gnad thams cad kyang rnam pa gcig tu na 'dir 'dus par rtogs so/ /bzhi pa mi 'bral bar bzung ba'i thabs phan yon dang bcas pa bstan pa ni/ de ltar tshul bzhin du byin gyis brlabs pa'i dam tshig gi rdo rje dril bu de nyid/ dus nam du'ang mi 'bral ba 'chang zhing / dkyil 'khor chen por ma smin pa'i gang zag dag la ni nyams nga'i 'phrang du yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang ldan pa gzhan la bstan na phrogs su dogs pas sbed pa/ ltar rang gi dngos grub yal du dogs pas/ rnam pa kun du sba zhing mi bstan la/ skal ba dang ldan pa'i gang zag dbang gis yongs su smin pa/ 'ga' tsam la brtan par bya ste/ rtsa rgyud brtag gnyis las/ gal te skal med mthong na ni/ /skye ba 'dir ni dngos grub med/ /yang dag rab sbyin ldan pa la/ /cung zad tsam zhig bstan pa nyid/ /ces gsungs so/ /'o na dus nam du'ang 'bral bar mi bya na/ dgos pa khyad par can gyi tshe ci zhig bya zhe na/ 'di la bla ma'i gsung gis/ nyan thos dag tu rloms byed pa'i/ /nang du zhag bdun gnas pa dang / zhes gsungs pa'i rigs pas gzhan don rgya chen por 'gyur ba sogs/ dgos pa khyad par can nges par/ mthong ba'i/ zhag drug 'bral du snang la/ zhag bdun pa'i tho rangs kyi tshe ltung bar 'gyur zhing / dgos med du zhag gcig bral na'ang ltung ba dang bcas par 'gyur gsung ngo / /mdor na mi 'bral ba sogs dam tshig dang sdom pa dran shes bzhin gyis legs par bsrung zhing bskyangs bas/

dam tshig gnas la/ mkha' 'gro ma rings na gnas kyang byin gyis rlob/ ces gsungs pa ltar/ dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams rings nas/ du zhing / byin gyis rlobs pa dang / mkha' 'gro dang chos bsrung rnams bran bzhin bsgo ba nyan la/ gzhan yang / dam tshig rab bsrung bsod nams kyis/ /tshe dngos grub ma lus pa/ 'di nyid la 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes bla ma dang yi dam mnyes pas mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub bde blag tu 'grub par 'gyur ba nyid do// ༈ //'dir smras pa/ deng sang dus kyi gsang sngags 'dzin pa rnams/ /phal cher rdor dril bzung dkrol shes tsam la/ /rnam gzhag 'di 'dra'i tshul la rmongs mthong nas/ /de dag rnams la phan phyir ngas 'di bshad/ /deng sang 'di na phyogs 'dzin log rtog can/ /'das pa'i sangs rgyas bye bas ma thul ba'i/ /skal ngan 'ga' zhig kho bo'i legs bshad la/ /smod pa srid kyang snying rje'i yul du zad/ /deng dus gong ma'i gsung rab dgongs 'grel gyi/ /rtsom pa'i ro 'dzin bsgyur la yid gzhung ba'i/ /kho bos rnam dpyod yid 'ongs bzhin legs la/ /'gran 'os yod na tshur byon grogs bgyi'o/ /'di sbyar dge dang dus gzhan dge ba rnams/ /gcig tu bsdoms pa'i bsod nams gzi 'od kyis/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i 'gal rkyen mun pa'i tshogs/ /drung nas bcoms te bdag cag dpon slob rnams/ /dus 'dir tshe rings nad med bsam don 'grub/ /bstan pa cher rgyas don gnyis mthar phyin nas/ /nam zhig tshe 'di'i snang ba nub ma thag /dpon slob kun kyang zhing mchog bde ba can/ /gang der lhan cig skyes nas rgyal dbang mchog /'od dpag med kyi zhal mthong gsung thos pas/ /sa dang lam gyi yon tan lhun rdzogs nas/ /bdag cag dpon slob rnams sprul bgrang yas kyis/ /khams gsum 'gro kun zhing der 'dren gyur cig /ces rdo rje dril bu'i rnam par bshad pa sngags 'chang rnams la gces pa'i nor rdzas zhes bya ba 'di ni/

khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po rigs ldan 'jam pa'i dbyangs sku mched dang / rigs thams cad kyi khyab bdag drug pa rdo rje 'chang rgyal ba mus pa chen po sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan la sogs te/ yongs 'dzin chos bzhin du spyod pa du ma'i gsung las skyes pa'i/ theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa dpal sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis yon tan rin po che du ma'i 'byung gnas dpal sa skya'i chos grwa chen po'i bzhi thog bla brang du/ me stag cho 'phrul zla ba'i tshes bcu bzhi sngags 'chang bstan pa'i nyi ma ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen gyis zab mo chos dbyings su mnyam par bzhag pa'i tshul bstan pa'i dus dran gyi mchod pa 'bul ba'i nyin legs par sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni shab stod pa bkra shis don grub kyis mgyogs par bgyis pa'o/ /'dis bstan pa dang sems can la phan pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'byung bar gyur cig sarba maṅga laṃ// //ka l+ya ṇa war+dhan+tu// //gcig zhus// ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 20 a myes zhabs/ rdo rje dang dril bu'i rnam par bshad pa sngags 'chang rnams la gces pa'i nor rdzas/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 21
